basics.name: Said Boudjelda
basics.label: Senior Lead Back-end Engineer · Software Architect
basics.summary: Software engineer for nearly twenty years, focused on improving systems, processes, and the experience of the people who build and use them. I specialise in back-end and distributed systems on the JVM — Java, Spring, Quarkus, Apache Kafka — with hexagonal, domain-driven, and event-driven architectures. Creator of Kates, an open-source platform for Kafka resilience testing, and an active open-source contributor. I apply AI-assisted engineering in my daily work, enjoy reviewing code, and have given workshops and talks on Spring Boot and Neo4j.

work.name: FDJ
work.summary: Reference expert for event streaming, keeping production Kafka clusters robust and solving the hardest issues.
highlights: Designed and operate a company-wide, multi-cluster, highly available event-streaming platform on Apache Kafka.
Built Kafka Connect pipelines, Kafka Streams applications, and Schema Registry governance (Avro, compatibility policies).
Automated provisioning, deployment, and monitoring with Helm, GitLab CI, and Kubernetes; defined SLOs, alerting, and capacity planning.
Coach teams on event-driven design, topic modelling, and consumer performance; lead architecture reviews.

work.name: BNP Paribas
work.summary: F.I.R.S.T. project: a from-scratch system routing transactional flows between BNP partners and SWIFT over SWIFTNet.

Hexagonal architecture, transactional outbox, immutable domain model and functional programming with Vavr.
Java, Spring Boot, Spring Integration, MongoDB, Testcontainers.
